why_best: This elegant emergence and dissipation establishes an elevated, cinematic tone that commands authority while maintaining visual sophistication.
why_bad: A sudden hard cut or aggressive directional wipe would break the contemplative, high-end atmosphere and feel unnecessarily harsh for a brand showcase.
trap: A weak execution will dwell in the unreadable state for too long or snap too abruptly into sharpness, ruining the gradual visual progression.
